capabilities: Arrange tasks in four Eisenhower quadrants
Drag tasks between quadrants and reorder them
Complete, revive, or delete tasks with undo
Edit task titles and due dates inline
Show due dates with overdue highlighting and task counts
disambiguation: Not a task capture or query plugin; it stores and displays tasks in its own matrix view rather than reading existing Markdown task lists.
extras: Tasks live in the plugin's own matrix view; the README does not say whether they are read from or written to Markdown files. Syncing relies on Obsidian Sync.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view and prioritize tasks by urgency and importance instead of as flat lists.
summary: Task board that arranges tasks in a four-quadrant Eisenhower matrix by urgency and importance, with drag-and-drop, due dates, and completion tracking.
